thread:
maria-support: Hi team, customer ACME (acct: acme-42) reports a trial banner in the Console showing $500 trial balance but their API usage shows full metering and charges. Can we investigate? They say the banner appeared 2026-03-09 14:02 UTC and then they made a request with service key sk-acme-01 and got billed.

tim-engineering: Can you paste the service key request logs and the Console account payload? Also any trace IDs from the API response.

maria-support: Pasting excerpts below. Console account JSON (UI):
```
{"account_id":"acme-42","trial_balance_cents":50000,"trial_active":true,"promo_code":"SPRING_TRIAL_2026","ui_flags":{"show_trial_banner":true}}
```
API billing response sample from their call at 2026-03-09T14:05:12Z with sk-acme-01: 
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "request_id":"req_0a1b2c3d",
  "usage":{ "tokens":312 },
  "billing":{ "applied_credit_cents":0, "invoice_item":"usage_9876" }
}
```

devon-billing: I see the Console shows trial metadata but the billing pipeline uses entitlement records from the grants DB. Can we confirm the grant exists for account acme-42?

kevin-sre: Quick check: grants service returned 404 for that account at 14:04:50Z in our logs. Looks like sync job failed earlier. I pulled logs: grant-sync job for March 9 at 03:00Z threw a DB timeout against grants-db replica-2.

maria-support: Customer reports they clicked "Activate trial" in the UI yesterday and immediately started sending requests. So UI may have optimistic state before backend grant persisted. They included a screenshot of the banner and a Console network trace showing POST /activate-trial returned 200.

tim-engineering: Do we have the activate-trial handler logs for that POST? Need to know if it queued a background job or wrote to grants DB synchronously. If it queued, race could explain it.

kevin-sre: Found the handler trace for tracing-id trace-activate-5f: it returns 200 before commit confirmation. Code path: write to kafka topic "grants-events" then return. Consumer (grant-writer) lagged ~2m at that time due to GC pause on one consumer pod. So writes didn't reach grants DB before customer made API calls.

devon-billing: So the billing pipeline consults grants-db directly, not the UI's optimistic flag. While grants absent, usage is billed normally. We need to either refund or apply retroactive credit and ensure grant-writer lag does not repeat.

maria-support: Customer asked for refund of the billed requests during the window (14:05 - 14:08 UTC). I told them we'd escalate and follow up.

tim-engineering: Action items: 1) Engineering: implement immediate read-after-write for activate-trial or hold 200 until grants-db confirms OR update UI to show "Pending". 2) SRE: investigate consumer GC cause and redeploy/scale consumers to remove lag. 3) Billing: create retroactive credit flow for these cases.

devon-billing: I'll prepare a manual credit of $12.50 (1250 cents) for the customer for the affected period; will record invoice note and reference request_id req_0a1b2c3d and trace-activate-5f. Also opening issue BILL-4027 to add automated detection of usages billed while trial_active=true in UI but no grant record present.

kevin-sre: For immediate mitigation, I increased grant-writer replicas from 2->4 and bumped heap size. Will monitor consumer lag metric.

maria-support: Thanks all. I'll confirm with customer once credit applied and share timeline for the fix.

oncall-bot: Incident template created: INC-2026-0310-03 (root cause: grant-writer consumer lag causing trial grant not persisted before API requests). Assigned to tim-engineering / kevin-sre / devon-billing.

maria-support: Follow-up note for support thread: tell customers to wait for confirmation page after clicking Activate trial until we mark it confirmed. Also update KB: "Why my trial banner shows but I'm still billed" with troubleshooting and expected timeline.

tim-engineering: I'll schedule a small code change to block 200 until grant acknowledged and open a PR with tests.

devon-billing: Credit applied and invoice note posted (credit_id cr_2241). Customer notified. Closing loop once docs updated.
